item.title: Amethyst is the purple quartz variety
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Amethyst belongs to the quartz mineral family, alongside citrine and rose quartz.
EXIMUTC view: Look for natural-looking color distribution, transparency and cutting quality.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/amethyst-description

item.title: Diamond is a crystal form of carbon
item.description:
GEMOLOGY FACT: Diamond is a carbon mineral with properties distinct from transparent substitutes.
EXIMUTC view: Seek an independent diamond identification and grading report.
Source: Gemological Institute of America https://www.gia.edu/diamond-description
